meta.description: Data collected on the ONIR CMS site and during demonstrations: purposes, recipients, retention and rights.
meta.ogDescription: Data collected on the ONIR CMS site and its demonstrations.

hero.title: Privacy policy.
hero.lead: This policy covers the ONIR CMS site and its demonstrations. It does not cover ONIR CMS instances self-hosted by third parties.

legalNotice: This translation is provided for information only. The French version is legally binding.

blocks.html: The data controller for the site and demonstrations is Onirtech, reachable at contact@onirtech.com.

items: Browsing and security: technical connection data (IP address, browser, requested page, timestamp, server logs) required for the operation and security of the site.
Contact and estimate: name, email address, message content and, where applicable, phone number and project information.
Demonstration: name, email address, optional additional contact details, messages exchanged with the assistant, generated sheets and consent timestamp.
Local preferences: light or dark theme, stored in the browser and not sent to a server.
Respond to contact requests and prepare an estimate.
Run the demonstrations and return the exchanges.
Qualify a request and allow the team to contact the visitor again.
Ensure security, prevent abuse and maintain the service.

blocks.html: Depending on the case, processing is based on the visitor's consent (in particular for the demonstration), on the performance of a pre-contractual request or on Onirtech's legitimate interest in ensuring the security and proper operation of the site, in compliance with applicable regulations.
The data is accessible to authorised Onirtech staff and may be processed by its technical providers:

items: OVH, for hosting the site and the database.
Infomaniak, for running the responses generated by artificial intelligence.

blocks.html: The data is neither sold nor transferred to third parties for commercial purposes. Providers may be located outside Madagascar; in that case, appropriate safeguards are put in place where required by regulations.

items: Contact and estimate data: 24 months from the last exchange, unless a legal obligation requires otherwise.
Demonstration data: 12 months from the last exchange, unless deletion is requested.
Technical logs: the period necessary for security and diagnosis, generally limited to 12 months.

blocks.html: You may request access to your data, its rectification, its erasure, the restriction of its processing or object to its processing, under the conditions provided for by applicable regulations. To exercise these rights, write to contact@onirtech.com.
You may also lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority.
The site does not use any tracking or audience-measurement cookies. The theme choice and certain demonstration states may be stored locally in your browser; this information is not sent to a server.

When an organisation installs ONIR CMS on its own infrastructure, it becomes responsible for the data processed in its instance. Onirtech does not intervene in this processing and invites each operator to publish its own privacy policy.
This policy may be updated to reflect changes to the site or regulations. The last update date appears at the top of this page.
